metadata.definition: One row per person listed on a faculty page cited by the universities database, per university, with the department rows that cite the page. The page lists the name under the title shown; nothing else is established by the listing. "om-list" rows are the same person as an OM List profile (same name and university) and carry that profile's source-reported doctorate, research status and verified first job; "om-list-name-only" rows share a name with one OM List profile at another institution and may be a namesake; "unverified" rows have no doctorate or first job known until a reviewer opens the person's own page and records the outcome under review. Extraction is heuristic and listed names can be wrong or incomplete; a page that blocks automated fetches or renders its list with scripts contributes nothing and is reported under pages.

pages.accessMethod: Individually opened and read in Chrome; complete rendered directory and all sections read. Structured names, titles and profile links captured from visible roster cards; no personal contacts saved.

ASU's public faculty and staff directory data (the search.asu.edu web-directory endpoint, queried with curl) has no record for him under 'Cun-Zheng', 'Cunzheng' or 'Zheng Ning', or among all 137 results for 'ning'. The same directory does list the other emeriti from the awards page that were checked: Constantine Balanis and David Ferry (Regents' Professor Emeritus), Joseph Palais (Professor Emeritus), Gennady Gildenblat and Richard Kiehl. The ECEE faculty-by-rank page (rendered in headless Chromium, because the ECEE site answers curl with a Cloudflare 403) does not list him either. His Alexander von Humboldt Foundation network profile (Humboldt Research Award programme, 2020; first funding 1 May 2022) gives his current position as 'Professor W-3 und Äquivalente' and his current institution as Shenzhen Technology University, College of Integrated Circuits and Optoelectronic Chips, Shenzhen, China. So he is a former ASU faculty member now at another university. No opened ASU staff page shows an emeritus appointment, and no page states a doctorate. Earlier check (2026-10-16): the Fulton awards listing was the only ASU page found, it gave no profile link, and web searches found no ASU profile, so his current status and doctorate could not be verified.

Diamond and Lars Hansen. It has no entry for Thaler between Richard Thakor and Alexander Todorov; he appears only in its Nobel Laureates menu, and /faculty/directory/t/richard-h-thaler still returns 404. A web search led to his Booth emeriti profile (read with curl). It shows 'Richard H. Thaler, Charles R. Walgreen Distinguished Service Professor Emeritus of Behavioral Science and Economics', with academic areas Behavioral Science and Microeconomics and a 2024 (Autumn) course. It states that he attended the University of Rochester, 'where he received a master's degree in 1970 and a PhD in 1974', and that he joined the Chicago Booth faculty in 1995. The University of Chicago online directory (curl) lists him with affiliation 'staff, emeritus', appointment 'Emeritus/Emerita, Professor', the Walgreen title and department 'Chicago Booth School of Business, Faculty'. He is confirmed as emeritus faculty, recorded in the same way as emeritus professors confirmed in earlier reviews. His area is behavioral science, not operations. The re-opened Nobel laureate page gives the same PhD (economics, University of Rochester, 1974). Earlier check (2026-10-16): the only page opened was the Nobel prize biography, which shows no current rank, and his faculty-directory profile returned HTTP 404.

review.reason: Re-checked on 2026-10-17. The Owen faculty directory, rendered in headless Chromium, has a 'Faculty Types' filter. With 'Adjunct' selected, page 2 of the filtered list shows Francisco Perez-Gonzalez with the title 'Dean (Business) and Professor of Finance at ITAM (Mexico City)', among adjunct professors such as Lewis Agnew and Jamison Monroe. The directory's own public data endpoint for that listing (group 301, read with curl) gives his entry facultytypes 'adjunct', academicprograms 'executive-mba,global-executive-mba-americas' and a blank subject area. So the school's own directory classes him as adjunct faculty in its executive MBA programs, a Vanderbilt appointment type that the earlier reading did not see. His profile page, rendered in headless Chromium, shows the same title and an Education section listing 'Ph.D., Economics, Harvard University' (no year), 'Masters, Economics, Harvard University' and 'B.A., Economics, ITAM'. His area is finance, not operations. Earlier check (2026-10-16): the Owen profile gave only his title at ITAM, with a blank subject-area tag and a Harvard PhD without a year, and the integrator kept the entry unresolved because no Vanderbilt appointment was stated.
